reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so I don't need sachets to go. Travel is only twice a month, and I can just pack a few of my own capsules.
objection: $29.99 a month is a lot more than the bottle I already own, and I'd be paying for portability I rarely use.
would_change_my_mind: A much lower per-day price than my current bottle, or a small travel-sized trial pack for my work trips only.
